:::{#def-surprisal}
#### Surprisal

The **surprisal** of a [value](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-realization) $x$ of a discrete random variable $X$
with $\P(X=x) > 0$ is

$$s(x) \eqdef -\log \P(X=x).$$

With base-2 logarithms, surprisal is also called the
**Shannon information content** of the value $x$
[@mackay2003information, section 2.4].

:::
